facts.fact: Business News reports that the new digital platform was put in place by the Ministry of Education, which the secondary teachers' federation says spent substantial funds on it and is imposing its use on schools.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme numérique du ministère de l'Éducation

facts.fact: The platform is used by school staff for pupils' enrolment, transfers between schools, automatic assignment and the pedagogical distribution at the start of the 2026/27 year, according to the secondary teachers' federation; no entry of attendance or results is described.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme numérique du ministère de l'Éducation

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education brought a new digital platform into service in schools ahead of the September 2026 return to school.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme numérique du ministère de l'Éducation

facts.fact: On 7 September 2026 the Fédération générale de l'enseignement secondaire (UGTT) called on school staff to boycott the new platform until it works, reporting failures in enrolment, pupil transfers, automatic assignment and pedagogical distribution days before the return to school.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme numérique du ministère de l'Éducation

facts.fact: No figure for schools using the platform is given; the ministry has put it into service in schools, while the secondary teachers' federation says it is still 'en phase d'expérimentation' and not ready to be generalised; the article names no school level and no primary school.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme numérique du ministère de l'Éducation

systems.tiers: schools ('établissements scolaires'); administrative staff enter enrolments, transfers and assignments

note: The platform is not named and no level is stated: the only level signal is that the protest comes from the secondary teachers' federation, so no levels fact is recorded. 'Experimentation phase' is the union's description of a system the ministry has already put into service, not the ministry's; the two last12 rows are the two sides of the same event.
